steps.caption: No auth, no API key, no payment
One GET searches every free asset
Each hit: id, license, GLB url, bytes
The live answer from the public API

posts.text: More than 3,900 free 3D assets now answer one GET on three.ws/docs/api-reference, served from Cloud Run on @GoogleCloud. Objects, characters and motion clips sit behind a single search with no authentication, no API key and no payment. Every word of the query has to match; when nothing matches all of them the search retries on any of them and marks the answer relaxed: true, so a phrase never dead-ends silently.

Each hit carries a direct GLB URL, its license and its byte size. Pages run 1 to 50 results with next_offset for the next page, open CORS, cached at the edge for 5 minutes. The same join backs the free MCP catalog tools and the assets CLI, so all three surfaces answer identically.
